**Finding submitted: deviation (MINCOMMIT), redlined to the fallback.**

- **What the document does:** § 8.1(ii) creates a "minimum monthly fee (Monthly Base Fee)"; § 8.13 makes all minimum monthly fees payable in advance, ACH-debited, for the full eight-year Term (§ 1.X); § 10.3(A) requires Customer to obtain the entire bundled Service set from M&I "during the Term." The only fee-reduction mechanic (§ 10.2/p0181) triggers only if **M&I** withdraws a bundled Service.
- **Why it fails fallback:** a multi-year take-or-pay with no Customer reduction right and no true-up — walk-away territory. The only exit is priced via the Termination for Convenience Fee, which I deliberately did not re-flag (that belongs to T4C/LD).
- **Cure:** a single inserted § 8.13A carrying only the three fallback elements — commitment limited to the then-current 12-month period, reducible on 30 days' notice, shortfall settled by a true-up rather than a penalty — with a narrow "Notwithstanding Section 10.3(A)" so the retained Term-long sourcing premise does not defeat the reduction right. No existing wording was altered.
